Q5028.reason: The recorded plan restricts use of the 10-acre lot for the benefit of the other subdivision lots, which fits a non-possessory use restriction enforceable in equity (an equitable servitude) better than an unenforceable puffery statement.

Q5787.reason: Transferred intent carries the intent to inflict only a slight wound (a battery) to the teammate, and with no intent to kill or cause grievous harm the unintended death is most likely involuntary manslaughter, though a depraved-heart murder theory is arguable.

Q5115.reason: Rapid glycolysis at exercise onset produces pyruvate faster than aerobic oxidation can clear it, so the excess is reduced to lactate.
